about: Every system of the mod, one C# file each.

rows.what: BepInEx entry, config, keys, Harmony, test mode; test mode also opens the armory (check armory-opens)
finds every PG3D gun, icon and English name in the player's install + download cache on a background thread, cached between launches
rows.reads: {game:pg3d}/Pixel Gun 3D_Data/StreamingAssets/aa and LocalLow/Pixel Gun Team/Pixel Gun 3D/AddressablesCache

rows.what: opens PG3D bundles and the bundles they reference (AssetsTools.NET); reads meshes, textures and sounds as plain data
turns a gun prefab into ULTRAKILL meshes, downgraded textures and decoded sounds
loadout (6 guns x 6 categories); builds weapon objects into GunControl slots
per-gun behaviour: fire rate, clip, reload, fire types, zoom, recoil, ammo HUD; ULTRAKILL's VCR OSD Mono font for the ammo counter; guns pivot on their own centre
Pixel Gun-style armory: category tabs, icon grid with names and stats, six loadout spots per category
